system.description: This palm-sized transmitter emits a constant frequency for up to 50 hours per tech level. A receiver of the same tech-level is usually required to receive the transmission and locate the beacon. A tech level 2 beacon can be detected within 1000km, TL 3 on the same planet, TL 4 within the same solar system, and TL 5 anywhere within the Milky Way galaxy.
